frame: TransmissionCore; X toward engine, Y transverse, Z up

evidence.inventory: SNL37,87,129,134,136,141,142,193,200,201,204,250. SNL134/141 identifies the 5/32x1 split pin with M4165, not M4150; the inherited main-shaft hole is removed. SNL250's separate mention is treated as a repeated nested pin, with that mapping explicitly reviewable.
evidence.mount: Direct-floor attachment is an engineering hypothesis, not a verified original detail. Source cap screw quantities/sizes are retained; screws enter from below M1937 into blind bores in bracket bosses. No threads in the 6mm floor are assumed. Engine-frame mounting remains an alternative requiring source resolution. Floor holes exist only in the development copy.
evidence.brackets: Profiles, stock, journals, hole pattern and transverse positions are estimates. SH953A is represented as a connected two-journal casting. Full SNL2 has engine left and transmission right: auxiliary controls are placed260mm rearward, with shaft25mm higher, not forward toward the flywheel. Relative vertical heights and journal identity are provisional; no calibrated overlay claim.
evidence.auxiliary: One SH953C, two SH953B, two M4172 and two No6 taper pins from the nested SNL37 assembly. Shaft orientation/length/diameter and lever profiles are inferred. M4172 reuses the existing definition; no extra definition or double inventory count.
evidence.rod: SH953D uses two source 3/4in nuts, two SH953E fork ends and two SH953F pin assemblies. The 1-7/8in pin length is modeled under-head; that convention, diameters, fork shape, nut dimensions and rod length are estimates. Each pin assembly contains one source 1/8x7/8in split pin; no extra washers.
evidence.taper: SNL specifies No6 x3in; HB188 says 2-3/4in. SNL selected. Modern Lawson product11541 corroborates 0.341in large end and 1/4in per foot taper; historical application is conditional. Flat end finish is simplified.
evidence.retention: The source 5/8x7/8 cup-point screw in M4162 bears on an estimated flat in M4150. Shaft diameter and three main keys stay unchanged. The unsupported main-shaft split-pin bore is filled; the actual source pin remains allocated to the pending M4165 bell-crank joint.
evidence.limits: Nominal threaded envelopes, no helical threads. Clearances are modeling fit allowances, not historical tolerances. Full brake anchor/carrier, forward M581 controls, engine/frame installation and historical registration remain unresolved. Regenerate from JSON; not live FreeCAD expressions.
evidence.cotters: Analytic cylinder/torus legs and semicircular eye, using the qualified formed_pin helper. The former swept/polygon-eye construction failed definition and installed STEP comparison. Source leg length retained; stock volume and head form are estimates.
evidence.orientation: The first trial incorrectly placed the auxiliary controls toward the engine and its inward lever intersected the flywheel. A second trial jogged the auxiliary journal outward but was discarded without further testing after full-source review. The selected arrangement follows the rearward/down operating-arm direction seen in SNL2. M4164 eye(-100,-40)mm, auxiliary shaft(-260,+25)mm and auxiliary lever drop65mm are mechanical estimates constrained by current floor height; source proportions remain unresolved.
